Senses.Explanation: Ksitigarbha is the bodhisattva whom Chan records bring into cases through an image with an outstretched hand, an underworld meeting, a jewel, and direct answers. This is the invoked pre-Chan figure as deployed in recorded exchanges, not every person, temple, or phrase that happens to contain the same two graphs.
